verdicts.evidence: Work Time A Mini Language Dive: students respond to 'What does this verse mean?' and 'Now what do you think the verse means?' (Responses will vary); students explain the concept of sunset by interpreting the text.
verdicts.rationale: All three clauses met. Work Time A has students explain concepts by interpreting: students respond to 'What does this verse mean?' and 'Now what do you think the verse means?' and explain the concept of sunset by interpreting the text. Students learn concepts by interpreting: students learn the concept of 'setting' (moving down) and respond to 'What does the boy experience when the sun is setting?' (The boy is reading a book with his dad and getting ready for bed). Work Time C has students construct texts to demonstrate understanding: 'students complete the Summer Sun Risin' response sheet by writing and drawing about the ending events of the story.' Full.
